python << 'EOF'
import parse

print("=== Additional edge case tests for R2 ===")

tests = [
    # Complex format specs
    ('{0:>5d}', '   42', (42,)),
    ('{0:05d}', '00042', (42,)),
    ('{0:+d}', '+42', (42,)),
    
    # Multiple digit fields
    ('{0:d} {1:s}', '42 hello', None),  # Note: {:s} matches whitespace in parse-python
    
    # Mixed digit and named fields
    ('{0:d} {name}', '42 world', None),
    
    # Width constraints with digits
    ('{0:3d}', '123', (123,)),
]

for item in tests:
    if len(item) == 3:
        fmt, text, expected_fixed = item
        r = parse.parse(fmt, text)
        result_str = f"{r}" if r else "None"
        status = "OK" if (r and r.fixed == expected_fixed) or (expected_fixed is None and r is None) else "CHECK"
        print(f"{status}: parse({repr(fmt)}, {repr(text)}) = {result_str}")
    else:
        fmt, text = item
        r = parse.parse(fmt, text)
        print(f"parse({repr(fmt)}, {repr(text)}) = {r}")
EOF
